task.title: Migrate simple actions and typography batch

batch.rollback: Retain the prior React source history and keep each cutover independently revertible until G14 stabilization.

resolutions.finding: Canonical action elements already adopt an existing Light-DOM native button marked with data-vf-action-control. React can therefore preserve a genuine HTMLButtonElement ref and native button attributes while canonical VyrnForge owns action state, accessibility synchronization, and vf-action behavior.
resolutions.sharedPrerequisite: Canonical action elements must preserve an explicit external native-control class so framework facades do not reimplement class merging.

resolutions.finding: The React typography API deliberately owns semantic native tags (p/span/div, h1-h6, label, small/code). The current canonical vf-* display elements render as fixed Custom Elements and do not provide a semantic-native adoption contract.
resolutions.requiredResolution: Keep only the semantic renderer narrow and explicit until the canonical display foundation supports semantic native-element adoption without changing public React DOM semantics. Styling/token contracts remain shared.

rules: Do not preserve HTMLButtonElement compatibility through a Custom Element type cast.
Do not change documented React semantic tags merely to claim convergence.
Prefer a shared canonical capability over framework-specific DOM mutation.
Legacy implementation removal remains a later MFD-1416 concern after stabilization.
